recent_observations = transpose(recent_obs_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the location name.
viewof locNameDropdown = Inputs.select(
  recent_observations.map(d => d.locName),
  {
    label: "Choose a location",
    unique: true,
    sort: true
    }
)
filtered_observations = recent_observations.filter(d => d.locName === locNameDropdown)

// Create a horizontal bar graph using Observable Plot.
Plot.plot({
  title: "Recent Observations for " + locNameDropdown,
  marginLeft: 150,
  height: filtered_observations.length * 25 + 100,
  width: undefined,
  x: {
    label: "Number Observed"
  },
  y: {
    label: "Species Common Name"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(filtered_observations, {
      x: "howMany",
      y: "comName",
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true },
      fill: "#888"
    }),
   Plot.text(filtered_observations, {
      x: "howMany",
      y: "comName",
      text: d => d.howMany,
      dx: -15,
      dy: 0,
      fill: "#fff",
      textAnchor: "start",
    }),
  ]
})
